=== SYNTHETIC-PDF TEXT FIXTURE ===
Generated by extracting d:\ClaimBlitz\ClaimBlitz_Synthetic_Medical_Claim_Report.pdf with PyMuPDF (fitz) — the SAME extractor routes.py::_extract_text uses for /process — and committed verbatim as `tests/_pdf_fixture.py::SYNTHETIC_PDF_TEXT` (4772 chars, 4 pages; repr()'d, never hand-transcribed). test_billing_lines_sum_to_total asserts the seven itemized lines (18000+8500+5460+2800+7250+3750+3000) sum to 48760.00 AND that each line label + amount + the 48,760.00 total literally appear in the fixture text, so any drift from the binary fails loudly. Integration tests upload SYNTHETIC_PDF_TEXT.encode('utf-8') as a .txt file; fitz fails to open it as PDF and _extract_text falls back to a UTF-8 decode, so the pipeline receives the exact fixture text offline.

=== LLM-MOCK DISPATCHER (conftest.py) ===
LLMMock.call_json monkeypatches AsyncLLMClient.call_json (class-level, so the deps.py shared _llm singleton is covered). It keys on the unique system_prompt marker in the prompt (Scanner 'Scanner Agent', OCR 'OCR/Extraction Agent', Validator 'Validator Agent', Clinical 'Medical Expert Agent', Policy 'Policy Expert Agent', Fraud 'Fraud Detection Agent', Risk 'Risk Assessment Agent', Judge 'Judge Agent', Communication 'Communication Agent') and returns a canned LLMResult(provider='mock'). It raises AssertionError if a prompt matches no marker, matches >1 marker, or hits a marker with no script — a missing script fails loudly instead of silently defaulting to processable:false (would otherwise abort every integration test at Scanner). A script value may be a dict, a callable(prompt)->dict, or an Exception (instance/class) that is raised to simulate a provider outage (TC10). golden_llm_scripts(**overrides) returns the full REVIEW-path script (Scanner processable:true; a complete OCR payload for the synthetic PDF; non-blocking analysts; Judge 'approve' that the code guard overrides to REVIEW via the policy/identity blocking conditions; Communication REVIEW drafts); per-test overrides replace a single marker's script.

=== TEST SPEED ===
test_process_pipeline.py has an autouse _fast_pipeline fixture that monkeypatches asyncio.sleep to a no-op (removes only the Supervisor's 1.5s inter-stage rate-limit delays; orchestration order and every agent call are unchanged). Unit tests don't run the Supervisor. Full suite ~11s.

=== NOTES / DECISIONS worth recording ===
- TC10 fails the CLINICAL (MEDICAL_EXPERT) analyst, not Policy. REASON: in the golden fixture there is no policy document, so policy_expert.analyze SHORT-CIRCUITS before any LLM call (FEAT-003) and cannot be made to raise via a scripted LLM failure. Clinical calls ask_llm_json with no try/except, so a scripted LLMAllProvidersFailedError surfaces -> Supervisor synthesizes the ABSTAIN('agent_unavailable') finding -> Risk (runs last, sees the ABSTAIN peer) adds the role-keyed 'clinical_unavailable' to RiskBreakdown.blocking_conditions. design §15 TC10 says 'e.g. a failed Policy agent', i.e. any analyst role; clinical_unavailable is the correct role-keyed condition here. (Risk's own LLM is wrapped in try/except so failing Risk would NOT abstain — Clinical/Fraud/Validator are the LLM-failable analysts.)
- TC9 (conflict preservation) builds the golden form, then sets patient.dob via the real claim_model.field_conflict() factory with two ConflictingValue sources (the OCR agent does single-document extraction and has no cross-document merge path to exercise). Asserts status==CONFLICT, both values preserved in .conflicts, path in form.conflict_fields(), and that RiskAssessmentAgent raises documentation_risk.blocking + adds 'document_conflict' to blocking_conditions — i.e. the conflict is not silently dropped and routes to REVIEW.
- TC-JUDGE1 asserts decision.rationale == the Judge's scripted reasoning ('Analysts broadly consistent.') to prove the outcome came from state.ruling (not _consensus_verdict/majority); the blocking guard forces verdict=FLAG/REVIEW but leaves the Judge's rationale intact.
- OCR golden payload reports diagnosis_codes as ['J18.9 — Pneumonia, unspecified organism']; the real OCR normalizer strips the trailing description so TC1 asserts == ['J18.9']. submitted_total matches the computed line sum, so the real billing cross-check upgrades submitted_total.status to VERIFIED (TC2).
